# Error Handling Property Reference

Generated from the compiled `ErrorHandlingProperties` configuration property class. All properties are under `smbtech.error-handling`.

<!-- generated by ./gradlew generatePropertyReferences; do not edit this file manually. -->

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `smbtech.error-handling.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables servlet error handling auto-configuration. Disable it to remove all framework error handling beans. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.logging.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables structured error reporting when StructuredLoggerFactory and CorrelationContext beans are available. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.logging.include-diagnostics` | `boolean` | `true` | Includes the internal diagnostic message in structured error events. It never changes the public Notification. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.metrics.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables the bounded-cardinality error counter when a MeterRegistry bean is available. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.metrics.metric-name` | `String` | `smbtech.error.handling.errors` | Micrometer counter name used for error code, category, and HTTP status tags. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.response.exposure` | `ErrorExposure` | `INTERNAL` | Global response exposure applied to every handled error after resolvers and customizers. Accepted values are INTERNAL and PUBLIC. INTERNAL returns the generic safe notification; PUBLIC returns the resolved notification after mandatory sanitization. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.response.include-field-violations` | `boolean` | `true` | Includes aggregated Bean Validation and binding violations under metadata.violations. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.response.metadata-allowlist` | `Set&lt;String&gt;` | `[resource, request, violations, rateLimit, path, retryable, security, category, oauth2, conflict, dependency, schemaVersion, correlationId, validation, http]` | Top-level notification metadata keys allowed in public responses. Allowed values are still recursively sanitized. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.security.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Registers Notification-based authentication entry point and access denied handler defaults when Spring Security is present. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.security.oauth2-metadata.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Includes OAuth2 details in public Notification metadata. The RFC 6750 WWW-Authenticate challenge remains enabled. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.security.oauth2-metadata.include-error-description` | `boolean` | `true` | Includes a static framework-controlled OAuth2 error description. Provider and exception messages are never exposed. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.security.oauth2-metadata.include-error-uri` | `boolean` | `true` | Includes the fixed RFC 6750 reference URI in public Notification metadata. |
| `smbtech.error-handling.security.oauth2-metadata.include-required-scope` | `boolean` | `false` | Includes scopes required by the protected operation. Granted token scopes are never exposed. |
